## Summary

Provide a short summary of the changes in this PR.

## Changelog entry (required)

Add a single-line changelog entry suitable for `CHANGELOG.md` under the `Unreleased` section.
Format: `- [Added|Changed|Fixed] Short description. (PR #123)`

Example:

- Added: `linked_clone` option to create linked instead of full clones. (PR #42)

## Related issues / PRs

- Link to issue(s) or PR(s) this change addresses.

## Testing

- Describe how this change was tested (e.g. `ansible-lint`, `--check` run, deployed a test VM)

---

### Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Changelog line present and accurate
- [ ] PR links the related issue (if applicable)
- [ ] Tests / sanity checks documented
